Ravi (CS): Heads-up — scheduling a compact 'Enable & Migrate' workshop next Fri (half-day). Need facilitators, intake form, and a short post-session office hour.
Zoe (Enablement): I can lead the morning onboarding walkthrough. Prefer 09:00 PDT slot. I will prepare a 10-min poll for feedback.
Kai (Solutions): I'll do migration clinic in the afternoon. Need two 1:1 slots (20m each) for high-risk accounts.
Lena (Customer): A quick ask from our side — can you include a short segment on dedicated vs hosted networking? Our infra team will attend.
Ravi (CS): Good call. Adding a 10-min infra decision blurb after the intro.
Zoe (Enablement): Intake form link (please forward to customers): https://forms.gle/enable-migrate-intake-example 
Kai (Solutions): Lab artifacts will be in the repo: https://github.com/redwood-internal/enable-migrate-labs — I'll tag sample prompts.
Lena (Customer): We'll mark two seats as private-concierge required.
reminder-bot: Reminder set: "Enable & Migrate workshop — facilitator check" 48h before event.
Ravi (CS): Cap hands-on labs at 18 seats. If overflow, we spin a second instance (Zoe + Kai to coordinate helpers).
Zoe (Enablement): I'll publish the signup sheet and timezone matrix by EOD Tue.
Kai (Solutions): I'll confirm helper roster and upload sanitized sample dataset by Wed.
Ravi (CS): Post-event: 24h feedback pulse + optional 30m office hour next Mon. Action items owners: Zoe -> poll, Kai -> datasets, Ravi -> invites/outreach.
Lena (Customer): Thanks — that works for our team.
